entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: A fifteen-year-old notorious sky pirate captain of the Dragon's Smile who sympathizes with the renegades, for a price.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage planeswalker and illusionist who accompanies Kari to find a way to take down Tezzeret.

entities.name: Ragavan
entities.description: Kari's begoggled white-furred monkey companion, whom she calls her prince.

entities.name: Depala
entities.description: A dwarf Derby Crows pilot with a red scarf and a white tattoo, one of the best pilots in Ghirapur, who pilots the Dragon's Smile.

entities.name: Ukti
entities.description: An old dwarven woman who runs First Launch and guards her secret sanctum.

entities.name: Laksha
entities.description: A Derby Crow who shows the group the Skysovereign through a lens apparatus.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: The renegade leader whose group lost the Aether Hub; Kari calls her a second mom.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The Grand Consul in the Spire whom Jace is here to stop.

entities.name: Consulate lieutenant
entities.description: A lanky Consulate officer who inspects Kari's disguised ship.

entities.name: Consulate officer
entities.description: An enforcer officer who captures Ragavan in a net and fights Kari in the air.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The government that locks down air traffic and has retaken the Aether Hub.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: Rebels grounded by the blockade who plan to strike the Spire with the Heart of Kiran.

entities.name: The Derby Crows
entities.description: An aeronaut racing society that joined the renegades politically and fought at the Hub.

entities.name: Kari Zev's fleet
entities.description: Kari's fleet of fourteen pirate ships destroyed by the Skysovereign near Lathnu except for the Dragon's Smile.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city of Kaladesh under blockade.

entities.name: The Aviaries
entities.description: A cluster of rooftop hangars atop some of the tallest buildings in Ghirapur.

entities.name: First Launch
entities.description: A restaurant and club for aeronauts whose attic holds Ukti's sanctum.

entities.name: Aether Hub
entities.description: Facility the renegades lost to the Consulate.

entities.name: The Spire
entities.description: The double-pylon tower and tallest structure in the city, where Tezzeret is.

entities.name: Weldfast
entities.description: A Ghirapur district near the Skysovereign's position.

entities.name: Lathnu
entities.description: A village destroyed by the Skysovereign where Kari's fleet was wrecked.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Jace's home plane where his sanctum is.

entities.name: Dragon's Smile
entities.description: Kari's up-swept-bow skyship, the last of her fleet.

entities.name: Skysovereign
entities.description: The massive Consulate warship designed as a pirate hunter, with a lightning cannon, which the skywhale brings down.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: The renegades' skyship, grounded by the blockade.

entities.name: Sun Chaser
entities.description: Kari's first ship and one of the illusory fleet.

entities.name: Skywhales
entities.description: Giant creatures that swim in aether currents and ram the Skysovereign.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: Blue energy Kari steals and uses as bait.

events.summary: Kari and Jace use Jace's illusions to pose as a Consulate vessel and steal canisters of aether from a Consulate collecting ship.
events.quote: smuggling canisters of their inventory onto her ship under the approving gaze of Consulate stooges

events.summary: Kari bluffs a suspicious Consulate lieutenant who doubts her age, with Ragavan's screech helping.
events.quote: Perhaps there's a reason you're still a lieutenant. Think on that.

events.summary: Kari tells Jace she fights for pay as well as the cause; Jace says he is here only for Tezzeret.
events.quote: I don't fight for freedom, and I certainly don't fight for free.

events.summary: At First Launch, Ukti reveals that Pia's group lost the Aether Hub and leads Kari and Jace to her secret sanctum.
events.quote: "Pia's group lost the Aether Hub. They're all scattered now.

events.summary: Kari introduces Jace to the Derby Crows, who were at the Hub with Pia.
events.quote: They were called the Derby Crows.

events.summary: The Crows show the Skysovereign blockading the city and say the Heart of Kiran cannot get past it.
events.quote: "There's no way Heart of Kiran 's getting through that monster,"

events.summary: Kari reveals the Skysovereign destroyed her fleet of fourteen ships near Lathnu, leaving only the Dragon's Smile.
events.quote: When it was done with my fleet, Dragon's Smile was the only ship to make it out.

events.summary: Jace says he has an idea after learning Kari knew her destroyed fleet well.
events.quote: "Then we have no time to waste. I have an idea."

events.summary: Kari addresses her raiders, five Derby Crows and seven crew, to cause enough trouble to attract the flagship.
events.quote: Cause enough of a stink for their flagship to take notice.

events.summary: Depala dives the Dragon's Smile into the Consulate blockade, scattering the formation, and the raiders deploy.
events.quote: Dragon's Smile soared between the first of the Consulate ships and through the gap in the blockade.

events.summary: Kari fights Consulate enforcers on the deck and in flight.
events.quote: Kari and the dwarf tumbled to the deck of Dragon's Smile .

events.summary: Jace conjures an illusory fleet from Kari's memories of her destroyed ships, which fills the sky.
events.quote: Her fleet had returned to her, and they were assembling to fill the space above a plaza

events.summary: The officer fires a net; Ragavan takes it for Kari and is carried off, and Kari chases the officer.
events.quote: In the next heartbeat, the officer was off—and with her, the net containing Kari's prince.

events.summary: Kari wrecks the officer's propeller with her sword and rescues Ragavan.
events.quote: Kari just winked at the officer, and shoved her sword into the spinning action of one of the four propellers

events.summary: The Skysovereign engages the illusory fleet; its lightning cannon blinds Depala, and Jace links her to his mind so she can see.
events.quote: So instead, he returned a favor.

events.summary: Kari meets skywhales in an aether eddy and decides to use the aether as bait.
events.quote: But then she stopped. And all at once, she saw it. Opportunity.

events.summary: Kari smashes jettisoned aether canisters, a skywhale rams the Skysovereign, and the flagship drifts to the ground.
events.quote: the whole thing listed to one side and drifted slowly to the ground.

relations.note: They work together on the heist and diversion.
relations.quote: your illusion won us all this

relations.note: Kari says Pia is like a second mom.
relations.quote: Pia and I are pretty close. She's like a second mom to me.
I, Kari Zev, captain of Dragon's Smile
Things are going well so far, wouldn't you say, my prince?

relations.note: Depala is a Derby Crows pilot.

relations.quote: It was designed to be a pirate hunter, and it was that and more.
the floating mass that dominated the airspace between the spire and Weldfast

relations.note: Jace says he is here for Tezzeret.
relations.quote: just know that I'm here for Tezzeret.

relations.note: First Launch's attic is Ukti's sanctum.
relations.quote: It's my sanctum. You treat it with respect.
